text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Public debt should drop to 68 percent of the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and revenue from privatisations could reach 525 billion escudos in 1997, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said in New York on Thursday.
- Petrol company Petrogal has been valued by Merrill Lynch at between 220 and 300 billion escudos, sources close to the process tell the paper.
- Portugal's cement company Cimpor is considering buying Brazilian cement company Companhia de Materiais Sulfurosos - Matisulfur, located in Grande Belo Horizonte, informed officials tel the paper.
- Solidarity and Social Security Minister Eduardo Ferro Rodrigues said pension rises in 1997 will be slightly higher than inflation.
- Public debt should stand at around 70.5 percent of GDP at the end of this year, Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco said in New York.
